projects.name: Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
A new analytics dashboard platform delivering three core capabilities: (1) ingestion and processing of customer CSV files, (2) log analysis over application logs, and (3) visualization components that surface both data domains through a unified UI.

Scope is decomposed into five milestones: Foundation & Architecture, Customer CSV Data Processing, Application Log Analysis, Visualization Components, and Integration/Testing/Launch. Every milestone is broken into tasks sized for single-owner execution, with dependencies wired so work can be parallelized safely across the data and frontend tracks.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-engineering, visualization, log-analysis

tasks.name: M1 — Foundation & Architecture
tasks.details:
Milestone 1. Establish the technical and organizational groundwork that both data tracks and the UI track will build on.

Exit criteria: architecture decision records approved, repository and CI pipeline green, storage schema provisioned, and shared data contracts (CSV customer schema + log event schema) published for consumers.

tasks.name: M2 — Customer CSV Data Processing
tasks.details:
Milestone 2. Build the ingestion and transformation pipeline that turns raw customer CSV files into clean, queryable customer analytics tables.

Exit criteria: pipeline ingests full historical CSV set plus incremental drops, bad rows are quarantined with reasons, and curated customer tables are queryable with documented SLAs.

tasks.name: M3 — Application Log Analysis
tasks.details:
Milestone 3. Build parsing and aggregation over application logs so the dashboard can report on error rates, latency, and usage patterns.

Exit criteria: logs are parsed into a structured event table, key aggregations (error rate, p95 latency, traffic volume) are materialized, and anomaly baselines exist.

tasks.name: M4 — Visualization Components
tasks.details:
Milestone 4. Build the reusable chart and widget library plus the dashboard pages that present customer and log analytics.

Exit criteria: a documented component library exists (with a11y and theming support), dashboard pages compose those components against real query endpoints, and the app meets agreed performance budgets.

tasks.name: M5 — Integration, Testing & Launch
tasks.details:
Milestone 5. Harden, validate, and ship the dashboard: end-to-end tests, performance/load validation, security and access review, documentation, and staged rollout.

Exit criteria: end-to-end suite green in CI, load test within SLA, security review signed off, runbooks published, and production rollout completed with monitoring live.

tasks.name: Author architecture overview and ADRs
tasks.details:
Produce a concise architecture overview covering ingestion → storage → query API → UI, and record 3–5 Architecture Decision Records for the choices that are expensive to reverse (warehouse engine, batch vs streaming ingestion, charting library, query API style).

Deliverable: docs/architecture.md plus ADRs 0001-0005 merged.
Done when: reviewed and approved by tech lead and one stakeholder from analytics.

tasks.name: Provision repository and CI/CD pipeline
tasks.details:
Create the monorepo (or two-repo split per ADR) with linting, formatting, unit-test runner, and a CI workflow that builds and tests on every PR. Add branch protection and PR template.

Deliverable: green CI run on main; branch protection enabled.
Done when: a trivial PR demonstrates lint + test + build all passing automatically.

tasks.name: Design warehouse schema and provisioning scripts
tasks.details:
Design the analytical storage layout: raw landing zone, staged/normalized zone, and curated marts for customer and log domains. Write idempotent provisioning scripts (IaC or migration files) that create databases, schemas, and warehouse roles.

Deliverable: schema diagrams plus runnable provisioning scripts in a dev environment.
Done when: a fresh environment can be provisioned from scratch with one command and verified.

tasks.name: Publish shared data contracts for CSV and log events
tasks.details:
Define typed contracts (e.g. JSON Schema / Pydantic models) for the customer CSV record and the application log event. Version them and publish to a shared package consumed by both pipeline and UI teams.

Deliverable: versioned contract package with generated types and example fixtures.
Done when: both the CSV and log pipelines validate sample records against the published contract.

tasks.name: Establish secrets management and access baseline
tasks.details:
Set up secret storage for storage credentials and service accounts, define least-privilege roles for pipeline vs. read-only dashboard access, and document the rotation policy.

Deliverable: secret store configured, roles created, access matrix documented.
Done when: no credentials live in source control and the dashboard role can read marts but cannot write.

tasks.name: Inventory and profile customer CSV source files
tasks.details:
Collect a representative export of every customer CSV variant in circulation. Profile each: column names, delimiter, encoding, null rates, duplicate rates, date formats, and known schema drift between files.

Deliverable: source inventory spreadsheet + profiling notebook committed to the repo.
Done when: every known CSV variant is catalogued with its quirks, and any variant that cannot be parsed is flagged to the data owner.

tasks.name: Build batch CSV ingestion with file registry
tasks.details:
Implement a loader that reads CSV drops from the landing zone, records each file in a registry table (hash, size, arrival time, rows read), and lands raw rows with a load batch id. Must be re-runnable without duplicating data.

Deliverable: ingestion job plus registry table and unit tests covering re-run and duplicate-file cases.
Done when: loading the same file twice produces zero net new rows and a clear registry entry.

tasks.name: Implement validation rules and bad-row quarantine
tasks.details:
Apply contract validation (types, required fields, date parsing, sane ranges) during ingestion. Route failing rows to a quarantine table with the original payload and a machine-readable rejection reason code.

Deliverable: validation module, quarantine table, and a reason-code catalogue.
Done when: a deliberately corrupted test file lands entirely in quarantine with per-row reasons and does not abort the batch.

tasks.name: Build customer normalization and curation models
tasks.details:
Transform staged rows into a conformed customer dimension (deduplicated by a deterministic surrogate key) and supporting facts such as signup date, plan/segment, and activity rollups used by the dashboard.

Deliverable: dbt models or equivalent SQL transformations with tests on uniqueness and not-null keys.
Done when: customer dimension has one row per real customer and dashboard-facing columns are documented.

tasks.name: Inventory log sources and build format catalogue
tasks.details:
Enumerate every application log source feeding the dashboard (services, file paths or sinks, rotation scheme). For each, document the format: JSON vs. plaintext, timestamp format and timezone, severity vocabulary, correlation/trace id presence, and sampling.

Deliverable: log source catalogue in docs with one real sample per source (redacted).
Done when: each source has a parser owner and a documented format, and unparseable/unknown sources are escalated.

tasks.name: Implement log parser for structured and plaintext lines
tasks.details:
Write a parser that handles JSON log lines directly and applies regex/grammar rules for plaintext lines. Extract timestamp, service, severity, message, latency, status code, and trace id where available. Unknown lines go to a parse-failure bucket rather than crashing.

Deliverable: parser module with a fixture-based test suite covering every catalogued source plus malformed input.
Done when: parse success rate on a week of production sample exceeds the agreed threshold (target 99%) and failures are inspectable.

tasks.name: Load parsed logs into structured event table
tasks.details:
Persist parsed log events into a partitioned event table (by day and service) with deduplication on a stable event key. Include a parse-failure table for triage.

Deliverable: loader job, partitioned event table, and dedupe logic with tests.
Done when: replaying the same log window twice yields no duplicate events and daily partitions prune correctly in a sample query.

tasks.name: Build log aggregation marts (error rate, latency, traffic)
tasks.details:
Materialize hourly and daily aggregates per service: request volume, error rate by severity, p50/p95/p99 latency, and top error signatures (normalized messages). Expose them as dashboard-ready tables.

Deliverable: aggregation models with freshness checks and documented column definitions.
Done when: aggregates reconcile with a hand-run query on raw events within 1% for a sample day.

tasks.name: Establish anomaly baselines and alert thresholds
tasks.details:
Compute rolling baselines (e.g. 7-day median with band) for error rate and latency per service, then define threshold rules that flag genuine deviations without excessive noise.

Deliverable: baseline job plus a threshold configuration file and a short noise-tolerance writeup.
Done when: replaying a week of historical data flags known incidents and produces an acceptable false-positive rate.

tasks.name: Implement PII redaction and log retention policy
tasks.details:
Scan log payloads for personal data (emails, IPs, tokens, user identifiers) and apply masking at parse time so raw PII never reaches dashboard tables. Define and enforce retention windows on raw vs. aggregated data.

Deliverable: redaction rules with tests and a documented retention schedule.
Done when: a canary record containing synthetic PII is confirmed masked end-to-end, and expired partitions drop automatically.

tasks.name: Scaffold component library with design tokens and theming
tasks.details:
Stand up the UI package: component directory structure, Storybook (or equivalent) preview, design tokens (color, spacing, typography), light/dark theming, and a documented contribution pattern for new components.

Deliverable: running Storybook with 2–3 placeholder components and a tokens file.
Done when: a developer can add a component and see it rendered in the preview environment.

tasks.name: Build core chart primitives
tasks.details:
Implement the chart set the dashboard actually needs: time-series line chart, stacked bar, donut/share chart, KPI stat card with sparkline, and a sortable/paginated data table. Each takes a typed data prop matching the shared contracts.

Deliverable: five primitives, each with stories and unit tests for empty/loading/single-point/large-series states.
Done when: every primitive renders correctly with 1, 100, and 10k data points without crashing.

tasks.name: Accessibility and responsive behaviour pass
tasks.details:
Audit the component library for keyboard navigation, focus visibility, color contrast, and screen-reader labels (including chart data tables for non-visual access). Verify layouts at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths.

Deliverable: automated a11y checks in CI plus a written audit with issues resolved or ticketed.
Done when: zero critical axe violations and every chart exposes an accessible text alternative.

tasks.name: Build query API client layer with caching and states
tasks.details:
Create a typed data-access layer between UI and the query endpoints: request builders with date-range and filter params, client-side caching/dedupe, retry, and consistent loading/empty/error states.

Deliverable: client module with generated types from the contracts package and unit tests with mocked responses.
Done when: a page can request filtered data and surface loading, empty, and error states without bespoke logic.

tasks.name: Compose customer analytics dashboard page
tasks.details:
Assemble the customer page from the primitives: growth over time, segment/plan breakdown, cohort or retention view, and a searchable customer table. Include global date-range and segment filters wired to the query client.

Deliverable: page with a layout spec and filter state persisted in the URL.
Done when: filters recompose all widgets consistently and a shared dashboard link restores the same view.

tasks.name: Compose log and observability dashboard page
tasks.details:
Assemble the log page: traffic and error-rate time series, latency percentile chart, top error signatures table, per-service filter, and a drill-down from an aggregate bucket to representative events.

Deliverable: page with service/severity filters and documented drill-down behaviour.
Done when: selecting a spike on the error chart filters the detail table to that window and service.

tasks.name: Set performance budgets and optimize bundle
tasks.details:
Define budgets for initial JS payload, largest contentful paint, and query response time. Apply code splitting, lazy-loading for chart modules, and data downsampling for long ranges.

Deliverable: budget config enforced in CI plus a before/after performance report.
Done when: the dashboard loads within budget on a throttled "fast 3G / mid-tier laptop" profile.

tasks.name: Schedule incremental CSV loads with idempotency
tasks.details:
Put the ingestion → transformation chain on a schedule (cron or orchestrator DAG) with retries, failure alerts, and a watermark so only new files are processed. Document the backfill procedure.

Deliverable: orchestrator DAG/job definition plus a runbook section covering retry and backfill.
Done when: the job runs unattended across a full week of drops and a manual backfill of a past date leaves current state uncorrupted.

tasks.name: Add data quality checks and reconciliation report
tasks.details:
Add automated assertions on the curated customer tables (row-count deltas, uniqueness, referential integrity, freshness) and produce a daily reconciliation report comparing source row counts to loaded and quarantined counts.

Deliverable: test suite wired into the pipeline plus a scheduled reconciliation summary.
Done when: a deliberately injected anomaly fails the pipeline check before bad data reaches the dashboard mart.

tasks.name: Build end-to-end test suite
tasks.details:
Write E2E tests covering the critical journeys: load a sample CSV → verify it appears in the customer dashboard; ingest sample logs → verify error-rate chart updates; apply filters and confirm widgets recompose; verify empty and error states render.

Deliverable: E2E suite running against a seeded ephemeral environment in CI.
Done when: suite is green, deterministic across 5 consecutive runs, and blocks merges on failure.

tasks.name: Run load and performance testing
tasks.details:
Load-test the query endpoints and dashboard under realistic concurrency (define the target, e.g. 25 concurrent analysts) and time the heavy aggregations against production-scale volumes.

Deliverable: load-test scripts, results report, and a list of bottlenecks with fixes or accepted risks.
Done when: p95 dashboard query latency meets the agreed SLA at target concurrency.

tasks.name: Complete security and access review
tasks.details:
Review authentication/authorization on the dashboard, confirm PII masking coverage, verify least-privilege warehouse roles, scan dependencies for known vulnerabilities, and check secret handling.

Deliverable: security review sign-off with all high findings closed.
Done when: no unresolved high or critical findings and the access matrix matches the deployed configuration.

tasks.name: Write user documentation and operational runbooks
tasks.details:
Produce end-user documentation (what each dashboard shows, how metrics are defined, filter behaviour) and operational runbooks (pipeline failure triage, backfill, schema-change process, on-call escalation).

Deliverable: docs site section plus runbooks in the repo.
Done when: a teammate unfamiliar with the project can complete a backfill using only the runbook.

tasks.name: Execute staged rollout with monitoring
tasks.details:
Roll out behind a flag to an internal pilot group, then expand to all analysts in stages. Wire dashboards for pipeline freshness, ingestion error rate, and query latency, with a documented rollback step.

Deliverable: rollout checklist, monitoring dashboards, and a rollback procedure.
Done when: full audience is live for one week with no Sev-1 incidents and freshness alerts functioning.

tasks.name: Time-series line chart component
tasks.details:
Build the line chart used for customer growth and traffic/error trends: multi-series support, time axis with sensible tick granularity, tooltip crosshair, and legend toggling. Accepts the typed series prop from the contracts package.

Deliverable: component plus stories covering single series, 5 series, single data point, and a 10k-point series.
Done when: renders correctly in all four story states and downsamples smoothly at 10k points.

tasks.name: Stacked bar chart component
tasks.details:
Build the stacked bar chart used for segment/composition breakdowns: stacking and grouping modes, value labels, and hover tooltips.

Deliverable: component plus stories for stacked, grouped, and single-category states.
Done when: axis and legend stay readable with 8 categories and long category labels.

tasks.name: Donut share chart component
tasks.details:
Build the donut/share chart for plan and severity distribution: percentage and absolute modes, centre total label, and an accessible data-table fallback.

Deliverable: component plus stories including a single-category and an all-zero dataset.
Done when: zero-value datasets render a clear empty state rather than a broken ring.

tasks.name: KPI stat card with sparkline
tasks.details:
Build the stat card used for headline numbers (active customers, error rate, p95 latency): big value, period-over-period delta with direction indicator, and an inline sparkline.

Deliverable: component plus stories for positive, negative, flat, and missing-previous-period deltas.
Done when: a null or absent comparison period renders without a misleading arrow.

tasks.name: Sortable paginated data table component
tasks.details:
Build the table used for customer lists and top error signatures: column sorting, pagination or virtual scrolling, sticky header, per-column formatting, and CSV export of the current view.

Deliverable: component plus stories at 10 rows, 10k rows, and with mixed null values.
Done when: sorting and paging stay responsive at 10k rows via virtualization.

tasks.name: JSON log line parser
tasks.details:
Parse structured JSON log lines into the canonical event shape: timestamp (with timezone normalization), service, severity, message, latency, status code, and trace id.

Deliverable: parser branch plus fixtures covering every JSON source in the catalogue.
Done when: all JSON fixtures parse to the canonical event with correct timestamp normalization.

tasks.name: Plaintext regex grammar parser for legacy log formats
tasks.details:
Implement the pattern-matched path for non-JSON logs, one named grammar per legacy format in the catalogue, with field extraction and a documented precedence order when multiple patterns match.

Deliverable: grammar definitions plus a fixture per legacy format.
Done when: every catalogued plaintext format parses to the canonical event shape.

tasks.name: Parse-failure bucket and error reporting
tasks.details:
Route unparseable lines to a parse-failure bucket with the raw line, source id, and reason, and expose counts per source so operators can spot a broken format immediately.

Deliverable: failure-bucket writer plus a per-source failure count query.
Done when: feeding a malformed file yields inspectable failures and never aborts the batch.

tasks.name: Parser fixture suite and 99% accuracy validation
tasks.details:
Assemble the full fixture suite across all sources plus malformed input, and run the parser over a week of sampled production logs to measure the true parse success rate.

Deliverable: fixture suite in CI and a short accuracy report per source.
Done when: overall parse success exceeds 99% and any source below threshold has a documented remediation ticket.
